lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of 4-5 high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly parallel rows along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots to create a regular grid-like configuration across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-intensity, high-luminance blobs scattered across the base and central area of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large semi-circular indentation on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin; multiple diffuse reddish-pink pigment anomalies on the mid-posterior lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated remoras (commensal fish) attached to the ventral surface and the area surrounding the pectoral fin insertion point.
